answer: The marble panel is drawn blind, the sonnet escrow settles at close, and glacier lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 17% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 179 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
